'''sodapop watto box is open''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list sodapop posted on DeckTech. The byline 'Soda "sodapop" pop' is a prank name, so the player's real name is not known; he is listed by his DeckTech handle 'sodapop' and no player page is made.<ref name="dt-21728">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/21728 watto box is open], DeckTech (Soda "sodapop" pop, 24 February 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/21728/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/21728/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015151115/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/21728/ Wayback Machine].</ref>
